description: case-specific operational scoring matrix for WWOX LEGEND triage. Scores relevance to the case's genotype, biology, therapeutic windows, repurposing and safety. It is triage, not evidence.

tiers.name: P0_FAST_TRACK
tiers.meaning: Immediate case-relevant review: allele, urgent safety, or concrete therapeutic window.

tiers.name: P2_MEDIUM
tiers.meaning: Useful discovery or endpoint signal; queue after high-priority items.

tiers.name: P3_LOW
tiers.meaning: Background or weak bridge; preserve, do not prioritize now.

tiers.name: P4_BACKGROUND
tiers.meaning: Very low case-specific value after current evidence.

axes.label: Q230P/protein-rescue
axes.rationale: Directly relevant to the case's missense allele and rescue-by-stabilization hypothesis.

axes.label: splice/ASO
axes.rationale: Directly relevant to the case's splice allele and ASO/SSO rescue logic.

axes.label: gene-therapy/AAV
axes.rationale: Relevant to replacement/bridge-to-GT strategy and delivery design.

axes.label: network/seizure/time-window
axes.rationale: Relevant to time-sensitive network stability, seizures, sleep and functional endpoints.

axes.label: myelin/glia/development
axes.rationale: Relevant to developmental window and network/myelin preservation.

axes.label: neuroinflammation/immune
axes.rationale: Relevant to modifiable inflammatory and glial-state hypotheses.

axes.label: metabolic/redox/mitochondria
axes.rationale: Relevant to WWOX metabolic state, stress response and druggable downstream biology.

axes.label: repurposing/concrete intervention
axes.rationale: Relevant when a concrete modulator or therapeutic class can enter hypothesis-forge.

axes.label: pediatric/rare-disease transfer
axes.rationale: Improves translational fit to the case and rare-disease workflows.

axes.label: BLOCK-1/safety
axes.rationale: High review priority for safety/evidence correction; not automatically therapeutic priority.

axes.label: functional evidence
axes.rationale: Raises priority when evidence is mechanistic/functional rather than association-only.

penalties.rationale: Pure association without mechanism is lower priority.
Oncology is valuable only when it carries WWOX mechanism, druggability, safety or transferable biology.
Animal/agricultural trait papers usually have weak case transfer unless mechanistic.

boosts.rationale: Safety/evidence correction needs attention even when therapeutic value is uncertain.
Catalogued but not deep-dived items may hide old value.
